1068-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1068-8266.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}. When it enters, it triggers, exiling your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.

1116-1385-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-1385-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

225-2577-6495-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
225-2577-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1865-2232-7827-7828.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
1865-2232-7827-7828.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-4985-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3617-4013-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Eldrazi Displacer.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

147-5147-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
147-5147-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

893-2511-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2225-3767-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures
2225-3767-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

855-1495-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2615-3499-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-3499-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

2525-3358-3499.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2921-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2921-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

488-874-1482-2895-4986.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Jeweled Lotus must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-1482-2895-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4865-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Shapeshifter on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Vesuvan Shapeshifter do not have summoning sickness.
4865-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

1308-2793-3743-5089-5435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1308-2793-3743-5089-5435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

190-389-5248-6124.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Herald of Eternal Dawn.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments and artifacts.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

2933-4013-4365.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2249-3192-4050.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-3192-4050.description:
Activate Ulasht's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.

2232-2421-2459-3148-4050.notablePrerequisites: Rograkh and You have enough mana to pay for Rograkh's commander tax, if applicable.
2232-2421-2459-3148-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {G}.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Thrasios to your hand from the battlefield.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {U}.
Cast Thrasios by paying {G}{U}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Thrasios enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

67-2281-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Reveillark.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Reveillark's power.
Repeat.

4067-5074-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Tower of Fortunes by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to draw four cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Tower of Fortunes.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-2034-4365.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least one +1/+1 counter.
1183-2034-4365.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

176-560-4050.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Repeat.

4013-4751-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Verdurous Gearhulk.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2050-3525-4495.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
New Horizons attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-4495.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by New Horizons, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.

32-1750-4903-5261.manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U}{U}, which can be reduced by having cards in graveyard to delve away
32-1750-4903-5261.description:
Cast the extra turn spell and move to your extra turn.
Activate Isochron Sceptre to cast Pull from Eternity, putting the extra turn spell from exile to your graveyard.
Attack with Backdraft Hellkite to give your extra turn flashback, then cast it.
Repeat for infinite turns.
